data.name: Hazal
data.gender_notes: Hazal is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Turkish word 'hazelnut', which comes from the Hazel tree. The name Hazal symbolizes the freshness and natural beauty of a blooming flower or a ripe hazelnut. The name Hazal carries the meaning “Flower” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Turkish. Parents who choose Hazal usually hope their child will grow to embody flower and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Hazal is a name rooted in the beauty and bounty of nature. It represents growth, renewal, and the cycle of life. The name is a reminder of the divine grace and abundance in nature and inspires a deep appreciation for the simple joys of life.
data.etymology: Hazal belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Flower.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hazal total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
